name: Pixie
ability: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.
wakes: First night; later, if the ability is gained, whenever that Townsfolk would wake.
interaction: Shown one in-play Townsfolk token; that player is marked with Mad.
drunk_or_poisoned: May be shown a false Townsfolk; if the marked player dies while the Pixie is drunk or poisoned, no ability is gained.

rulings.text: Only the real marked Townsfolk dying counts; a Minion bluffing that character dying gives nothing.
The Storyteller judges madness; sharing a claim without disputing it, or admitting to being the Pixie, likely fails.
If the marked player changes character and then dies, the Pixie gains the original Townsfolk ability.
Night order numbers are from bra1n/townsquare src/roles.json (develop branch), not the botc-release list.

test_scenarios.name: mad and gains
test_scenarios.setup: 5 players: seat 0 Pixie, 1 Washerwoman, 2 Chef, 3 Poisoner, 4 Imp
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Pixie shown Washerwoman; Pixie claims Washerwoman all day; Washerwoman executed
test_scenarios.expected: Has ability reminder; Pixie gains the Washerwoman ability

test_scenarios.name: poisoned first night
test_scenarios.setup: Same setup; Poisoner poisons Pixie on night 1
test_scenarios.expected: May be shown a not-in-play Townsfolk
